title: Category:Boss-like foes
wikitext:
These foes are placed in key or critical points in a storyline or quest, and possess some of the attributes of a [[boss]], including double inflicted damage in [[Nightfall]] and [[Eye of the North]]. However, they are not true bosses.
* They do not have innate health regeneration.
* You cannot use a [[Signet of Capture]] to obtain skills from them.
* They do not have a glowing aura. 

[[Category:NPCs by trait]]
